home.tagline: Gods, heroes and monsters of the old myths, set tile by tile into a vault of night.
home.promise: Free to play, start to finish. Nothing is sold, nothing is tracked, and it all works offline.

atlas.heading: {count, plural, one {One tradition} other {# traditions}}
atlas.body: Every pantheon has its own corner of the vault and its own border. Cards follow the myths as they were first written down, and each one names its source.

ways.heading: How the vault fills

collect.title: Collect
collect.body: Each card you earn lights its tile. The gaps stay dark until you find what belongs there.

summon.title: Summon
summon.body: Spend the starlight you earn in play. Every banner prints its rates, and bad luck has a ceiling.

battle.title: Battle
battle.body: Choose four or five, set the formation, and watch the fight play out turn by turn.

ways.soon: Every part of the game is open. New figures and pantheons join the vault over time.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.languageHint: Picked from your browser the first time. Saved on this device only.

motion.systemHint: Uses your system’s reduced motion setting.
motion.fullHint: Every ceremony, sheen and drifting cloud.
motion.calmHint: Fades instead of movement. Nothing is skipped.

privacy.heading: Your data
privacy.body: Tesserae never connects to a server. Your collection lives in this browser, and only you can move it.

footer.license: Free and open source under the MIT license.

collection.heading: The vault
collection.intro: Every card you own is a lit tile. Dark tiles are figures still waiting to be found.
collection.errorBody: Your save could not be read ({message}). Nothing has been deleted.

filters.label: Filter the vault
filters.matches: {count, plural, =0 {No tile matches. Loosen a filter.} one {# tile matches} other {# tiles match}}

detail.missing: Not found yet. Summon or win battles to light this tile.

summon.heading: Summon
summon.intro: Spend starlight to call figures out of the myths. The odds are printed here and never change behind your back.

banner.label: Banners
banner.standingBody: Every figure in the vault can answer.
banner.featuredBody: Half of the Demigod, God and Primordial results come from the {pantheon} tradition.
banner.ends: Changes in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

pity.heading: Guarantees

pity.god: God or better within {count, plural, one {# pull} other {# pulls}}

summon.short: You need {missing, number} more starlight. Daily quests give more.

history.empty: Nothing summoned yet. Your pulls will be listed here, newest first.

quests.heading: Today’s quests
quests.resets: New quests every day at midnight.

titles.open-three: Open three cards in the vault
titles.read-a-myth: Turn a card over and read its myth

ceremony.label: Summoning

battle.heading: Battle
battle.intro: Set four or five cards in formation and let the fight play out on its own.
battle.locked: Win the previous stage to open this one.

tower.body: Each floor is harder than the last. The tower remembers how high you climbed.

boss.body: One enemy, many times stronger than usual.

team.heading: Formation
team.hint: Pick a card to place it in the first empty slot; pick a placed card to take it off. The front row is hit first.
team.full: The formation is full. Take a card off first.
team.noSynergy: No shared tradition yet. Two or more cards from one pantheon fight better together.
team.invalid: A team needs four or five different cards.

result.xp: Each card in the team gained {xp} experience.
